title: Paystride Program Tier Lineup: Headcount Bands and Account Services
content:
The Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement is offered in six tiers. An employer's tier is the one whose headcount band contains its eligible headcount; each tier carries the account services shown.

| | Starter | Growth | Professional | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eligible headcount band (employees) | 1 to 49 | 50 to 249 | 250 to 999 | 1000 to 4999 | 5000 to 19999 | 20000 to 500000 |
| Dedicated customer success manager assigned | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Employer may use the Paystride reporting API | no | no | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Employer administrator seats included | 2 | 5 | 10 | 25 | 50 | 100 |

## Points of judgement

- Each band includes both of its ends: an employer with an eligible headcount of exactly 250 falls in the Professional band, and one with 249 in the Growth band.
- Reporting API access begins at the Paystride Program Enterprise tier; a dedicated customer success manager begins at the Professional tier.
